name: Numeric / date / quantity mismatch
meaning: answer's number/date/quantity differs from the context

name: Entity / term substitution
meaning: one entity or term replaced by another

name: Unsupported addition (extrinsic)
meaning: answer adds content not in the context

name: Subtle intrinsic contradiction
meaning: subtle contradiction / reasoning error with the context

name: Paraphrase / lexical divergence
meaning: answer is faithful but worded differently from the context (false alarm)

name: Context truncation loss
meaning: evidence was cut off by truncation

name: Code-switch / script mismatch
meaning: script or language mismatch (Bengali vs Latin)

name: Numeral / Unicode normalisation variant
meaning: Bengali vs ASCII digit variant only
